source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    sixes = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 6]
    one_segments = []
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i + 1:]:
            dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
            if abs(dr) == abs(dc):
                sr = 1 if dr > 0 else -1
                sc = 1 if dc > 0 else -1
                length = abs(dr)
                segment = []
                for k in range(length + 1):
                    r, c = r1 + sr * k, c1 + sc * k
                    segment.append((r, c))
                    if out[r][c] != 6:
                        out[r][c] = 1
                one_segments.append(set(segment))
    if any((r, c) in segment for r, c in sixes for segment in one_segments):
        for r, c in sixes:
            # Sixes project a complete diagonal of the opposite slope.
            for k in range(-h, h + 1):
                rr, cc = r + k, c - k
                if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                    out[rr][cc] = 6
    return out
'''
